name: Excalidraw
description: The hand-drawn-style whiteboard, served from one static container. Drawings live in the visitor's browser until exported; live collaboration rooms need the separate room server this template does not include.

access.note: Excalidraw has no accounts and no login: anyone who reaches this address gets the editor. Nothing is saved on the server — a drawing stays in that visitor's own browser storage until they export it — so the risk of an open address is strangers using your copy, not reading your drawings. Put the domain behind the dashboard's password protection if that matters.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

update.notes: Stateless. Docker Hub publishes this image only as a moving latest tag, so the definition pins the content digest of the build it was reviewed with; a newer build is a new digest in this definition, not a tag.
